narrative_engine.thesis: range balance regime (H4 stack down / D1 down · EMA spread -2.45 ATR (flat) · VWAP z 0.55σ oscillating) with no validated M1 pullback and no ±2σ M2 stretch — no edge is paying for the risk right now. Re-evaluate on the next footprint signal or a VWAP band touch.

funding: no per-venue OI available — oiWeightedRate8h is the equal-weight mean
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
